label: preparing
what: The innkeeper is coordinating a civic supper in the great hall tomorrow at eighteen hundred, with bread and lighting privately supplied. Its initially concealed purpose may be a celebration of my forty years as mayor: the request to escort me while calling it routine business suggests a surprise, though this purpose is not confirmed. Secretary knowingly arranges the hall and escort; freight and baker help secure provisions. I have been told about the supper, but not any commemorative purpose.
